TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY NO. 01 FOR NORTH INDIAN OCEAN (THE BAY OF
BENGAL AND ARABIAN SEA) ISSUED AT 1200 UTC OF 01.11.2026 BASED ON 0900 UTC
OF 01.11.2026 *
Sub: Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu] over Southwest & adjoining Westcentral
Bay of Bengal.
The Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu]” over Southwest & adjoining Westcentral Bay of
Bengal moved west-northwestwards with speed of 27 kmph during past 6 hours and lay centered at 0900
UTC of today, the 01st November, 2026 over the same region near Latitude 12.4°N and Longitude 84.6°E,
about 480 km east-southeast of Chennai (Tamil Nadu, 43279), 550 km east-southeast of Nellore (Andhra
Pradesh, 43245), 560 km southeast of Machilipatnam (Andhra Pradesh, 43185), 600 km southeast of
Ongole (Andhra Pradesh, 43221) and 610 km south-southeast of Vishakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh,
43149).
It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify further into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over
Westcentral Bay of Bengal around 0000 UTC of 2nd November. Thereafter, it is very likely to move
northwestwards and cross south Andhra Pradesh coast as a Severe Cyclonic Storm with wind speed of
100 to 110 kmph gusting 120 kmph between Nellore (Andhra Pradesh, 43245,) and Narsapur (Andhra
Pradesh, 43187) during 1800 UTC and 2230 UTC of 2nd November, 2026.
